name: Simple Octets
description: Octets: half-block cubes (0.5 x 0.5 x 0.5) of every wood, every block with stairs and slabs and the melon, which mix in one cell. Cut in the Shapecutter of Simple Blocks (in the stonecutter without it), crafted back into the block; the sledgehammer of Simple Hammers carves them and breaks one corner off a full block. Unwaxed copper octets age like Vanilla copper. Melon placing and corner breaking can be switched off (simpleoctets-server.json). Octets of SimpleBuilding's and Simple End's blocks only with that mod.
